label: Programme introduction
text: Please welcome our host. You know her voice from the Mid-Morning Show, and she is here to keep us connected all the way through: Imelda Mutio.

label: Short bio
text: Imelda Mutio is a Nairobi MC, event host and voice-over artist. She presents the Mid-Morning Show on Classic 105 and brings the warmth, energy and quick thinking of live radio to events, brand campaigns, ads and voice-overs.

label: Full bio
text: Imelda Mutio is an MC, event host and voice-over artist with a warm, natural conversational style. She started at Classic 105 as an intern and, through hard work and determination, earned her own slot on the midnight show before moving to daytime radio. Today she hosts the Mid-Morning Show, weekdays from 10am to 3pm, connecting with listeners through music, stories, lifestyle conversations, guest interviews and her daily Dilemma of the Day. Beyond the studio, Imelda lends her voice to commercials, explainers and brand campaigns, and hosts live events from corporate sessions and panels to galas and festival stages. Live radio has shaped her ability to communicate clearly, think on her feet and keep an audience connected. She is based in Nairobi.
